name: Love Love Teatime
original_name: らぶらぶティータイム
source:
Main character gets a part-time job at a coffee shop. There are really cute waitresses working there, but is it possible to go out with a girl met at work?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-may-2001-sapphism-no-gensou.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角在一家咖啡廳打工。店裡有幾名非常可愛的女服務生，可是，與工作中認識的女生交往真的可行嗎？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-may-2001-sapphism-no-gensou.html]vndbreview[/url]]
